info.name: Overdraft Facility Management API
info.description: End-to-end test collection. Run folders 00 -> 11 in order (Collection Runner / Newman). See docs/POSTMAN-TESTING-GUIDE.md for the detailed steps and expected values.

item.name: 00 - Health check
item.description: Confirms the application is up before running the scenario.

request.description: Pre-condition: application running on {{baseUrl}}. Expected: 200 and an OpenAPI 3 document listing all 7 endpoints.

item.name: 01 - Account opening
item.description: Opens the OD account used by the whole scenario and stores its number in {{accountNumber}}.

request.description: Creates a new ACTIVE account: sanctioned 1,500,000.00, rate 12%, billing cycle day 1. A fresh runId is generated so every collection run uses unique references. The returned accountNumber is saved to the collection variable {{accountNumber}}.
Expected: zero utilization, full limit available, no transactions, no interest log.

item.name: 02 - Scenario Day 1: draw 3L, run EOD
item.description: Day 1 (business date {{day1}}): withdraw 300,000 from the 1,500,000 limit at 12% and run end-of-day accrual. Expected daily interest = 300000 x 12 / 36500 = 98.6301.

request.description: Debits the credit line: utilized 0 -> 300,000; available 1,500,000 -> 1,200,000. referenceId makes the call idempotent per account.
Runs the EOD job for {{day1}}. The summary covers ALL active accounts in the database, so per-account results are asserted on the statement in the next request.
One ledger row for Day 1: balance 300,000, accrued 98.6301. Unbilled bucket = 98.6301 and principal is unchanged (no daily compounding).

item.name: 03 - Scenario Day 2: keep balance, run EOD
item.description: Day 2 (business date {{day2}}): no transactions; balance stays 300,000. Expected accrual 98.6301 again; cumulative 197.2602.

request.description: Runs the EOD job for {{day2}}.
Two ledger rows; cumulative unbilled interest 197.2602.

item.name: 04 - Scenario Day 3: repay 1L, run EOD
item.description: Day 3 (business date {{day3}}): repay 100,000 so the balance drops to 200,000, then run EOD. Expected accrual 200000 x 12 / 36500 = 65.7534; cumulative 263.0136.

request.description: Partial repayment, zero prepayment penalty: utilized 300,000 -> 200,000; available 1,200,000 -> 1,300,000.
Runs the EOD job for {{day3}} using the reduced closing balance.
